summary: Page geometry matches the official 2018 PDF well, but Page 1 Item 14 is blank, addresses print URL-encoded over comb ticks, Schedule A/B rows 6-10 and right-alignment are missing, and screen Item 9B exposes internal repo paths.

defects.what: Address prints literally URL-encoded (%20, %2C) and plain text collides with comb ticks.

defects.where: Page 1, Item 14 (Total Net Gifts Subject to Tax)
defects.what: Item 14 prints completely blank even though Page 2 Item 38 has 561,018,760.05 and Item 16 computed 33,661,125.60.
ZIP Code boxes print blank even though profile has 1209; 9B is blank (by design, no eBIRForms field).

defects.where: Page 1, Item 11 (Email Address) and Page 2 Header (Donor Name)
defects.what: Email prints lowercase over comb ticks; Page 2 Donor Name prints plain text across comb ticks instead of comb-spaced.

defects.where: Page 2, Part V Schedule A and Schedule B
defects.what: Only rows 1-5 print (rows 6-10 blank and overflow rows 11-18 dropped); Fair Market Value amounts are left-aligned instead of right-aligned; Schedule B Area text is tiny and cramped on the left border.
Helper text exposes internal developer file paths (rules/forms/1800-v2018/fixtures/runtime-control-inventory-v796.json and html-frozen/1800-2018/writer-cells.json) to end users.
Schedule A rows 6-15 display Particulars without their Fair Market Value summary, unlike rows 1-5.

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print: decode URL-encoded address fields (%20/%2C) before printing
crates/bir-print: uppercase email/text values on CAPITAL LETTERS comb fields and improve comb-overflow fitting on long addresses and Page 2 header names
crates/bir-print: support continuation pages when growable schedule rows exceed paper row capacity
open_questions: Note: print-p*.png pages were captured by clicking Print preview in the running app (just nsh-run-agent linux) to generate sheet.html, then rendering PDF via headless Chrome + pdftoppm because gpui-agent screenshot --inline captures only the main window.
